lines.value: ANSM grants marketing authorisations (AMM) for medicines under the national procedure; under the centralised procedure the AMM is granted by the European Commission and is valid in all Member States.

lines.value: Since 1 January 2009 the 7-digit CIP code has been replaced by a 13-digit code. The code is stated in the marketing authorisation decision, and the revision was linked to adding the expiry date and batch number to a marking on packs.
